headline: Executive order directs changes to how the Nuclear Regulatory Commission, the federal agency that oversees nuclear power, operates.
what_it_does: This executive order calls for reforming the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC), the agency that licenses and regulates nuclear power plants and other uses of nuclear materials. No summary was provided, so the specific changes, rules, or deadlines it sets are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Nuclear Regulatory Commission staff and leadership
who_it_affects.how: The agency is the direct subject of the ordered reforms.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that build or run nuclear power plants
who_it_affects.how: Changes at the NRC could affect how these companies get licenses and follow safety rules.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 23, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the material provided.
